name: text-to-cad
readmeExcerpt:
Design physical products with AI. [Website](https://www.texttocad.dev)
# text-to-cad The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows for generating 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files. It also does design for manufacturing checks, generates engineering drawings, and connects to popular 3D printing, sheet metal and CNC fabrication services. It is supported by all popular agents that support plugins or the [skills](https://skills.sh) framework, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and Grok. ### How it works 1. Your agent writes each model as a Python script with [build123d](https://github.com/gumyr/build123d), built on [Open CASCADE](https://dev.opencascade.org). 2. Running the script, `python model.py`, builds the model with text-to-cad's server into an `.xbf` document (its parts, names, colours, materials and joints) and the STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files the script declares. The server keeps each model's work in memory, so an edit rebuilds only what it changed. 3. The CAD viewer shows the model in your agent app or your browser, and follows every rebuild. ## 🚀 Quickstart macOS and Linux: ```bash curl -fsSL https://texttocad.dev/install.sh | sh ``` Windows, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://www.texttocad.dev/install.ps1 | iex ``` It installs uv if it is missing, then sets up text-to-cad in every agent app on your computer with each app's own commands (the plugin, which brings the skills and CAD's MCP server, or for an agent without a plugin the skills alone), registers the `cad` command, and moves CAD's server to the new release. Run it again to update everything, or click CAD's update button when it shows one; it lists the apps to restart. Then ask your agent for a part or an assembly: it writes the model as a Python script, runs it to build the model and shows it in the CAD viewer. Installing by hand, app by app, and updates: [docs/install.md](docs/install.md) ## 🧰 Skills Install the library to give agents focused workflows for CAD, fabrication, robot description files, simulation, and local review. | Skill | Summary | Source | | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | | CAD | Creates and edits CAD models from plain-language or image requests as Python scripts, built into XBF documents with STEP, STL, 3MF and GLB exports. | [skills/cad](skills/cad/SKILL.md) | | step.parts | Finds off-the-shelf STEP parts like screws, bearings, motors, and connectors. | [skills/step-parts](skills/step-parts/SKILL.md) | | Engineering Drawing | Dimensioned engineering drawings from a part, as a PDF: views, hidden lines, dimensions, hole callouts, title block. | [skills/engineering-drawing](skills/engineering-drawing/SKILL.md) | | DXF | Creates 2D DXF drawings like profiles, templates, gaskets, and cut layouts from Python sources or CAD geometry. | [skills/dxf](skills/dxf/SKILL.md) | | URDF | Writes robot structure files with links, joints, limits, inertials, and meshes. | [skills/urdf](skills/urdf/SKILL.md) | | SRDF | Adds MoveIt planning groups, end effectors, poses, and collision rules to a URDF. | [skills/srdf](skills/srdf/SKILL.md) | | SDF | Creates simulator models and worlds with frames, physics, sensors, and lights. | [skills/sdf](skills/sdf/SKILL.md) | | SendCutSend | Checks DXF and STEP files before upload to SendCutSend. | [skills/sendcutsend](skills/sendcutsend/SKILL.md) | | DfAM Check | Measures mesh printability per process: wall thickness, overhangs, support volume, and build orientation. | [skills/dfam-check](skills/dfam-check/SKILL.md) | | DFM | Reviews a part for sheet metal, CNC machining, or injection molding, with measured evidence and the cited rule behind every finding; measures draft, undercuts and projected area from a mesh. | [skills/dfm](skills/dfm/SKILL.md) | | G-code | Slices models into printer-ready G-code with OrcaSlicer, using your own printer presets. | [skills/gcode](skills/gcode/SKILL.md) | | Bambu Labs | Sends prints to Bambu Lab printers through Bambu Connect, Bambu Lab's official app, or Bambu Studio. | [skills/bambu-labs](skills/bambu-labs/SKILL.md) | ## 🛠️ Contributing text-to-cad is MIT-licensed and built in the open. - **Bugs and plugin requests**: [open an issue](https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad/issues/new). A bug report with the model script and the output of `cad doctor` is the fastest to fix, and an agent app without a plugin gets one on request. A security problem is reported privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says. - **Questions, ideas and what you made**: the [Discord](https://discord.gg/5FGB9DwJYU). Say what the skills got wrong, too: that is what improves them. - **Code, skills and models**: a new skill (a fabrication service, a printer, a CAD workflow) goes in `skills/`, an example model in `models/`, and fixes anywhere. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the local setup and how to test in the agent apps; an agent working in the repository starts at [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). By default, text-to-cad sends usage stats and crash reports, tagged with a random ID and never including your files, paths or prompts. The [privacy policy](https://www.texttocad.dev/privacy-policy) says what is sent and how to turn it off.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An AI-powered tool that generates programmatic CAD files directly from natural language text prompts.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Text-to-CAD is an innovative application that allows users to generate Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models simply by describing the desired object using natural language text prompts. It leverages Large Language Models to interpret the text and construct the 3D geometry programmatically, typically outputting code that defines the shape. This approach bridges the gap between conceptualization and 3D modeling, enabling rapid prototyping without requiring extensive knowledge of complex, graphical CAD software interfaces. It exports generated models into standardized formats like STEP, STL, and GLB, facilitating downstream fabrication and simulation.
keyFeatures: Natural Language Interface: Generate CAD models by describing them using everyday text prompts.
LLM Integration: Utilize Large Language Models to accurately interpret spatial descriptions and design intent.
Programmatic CAD Generation: Translate LLM output into precise programmatic instructions to define 3D geometries.
Rapid Prototyping: Significantly accelerate the initial design phase by automating the creation of basic 3D structures.
Code-Based Output: Produce designs in a programmatic format, allowing for version control and precise parametric adjustments.
Multi-Format Export: Export designs to standard CAD formats like STEP, STL, 3MF, and GLB for universal compatibility.

useCases.title: Rapid Concept Generation
useCases.description: Quickly visualizing a product idea by typing a description and instantly receiving a basic programmatic 3D model.

useCases.title: Accessible 3D Modeling
useCases.description: Enabling individuals without formal CAD training to create custom 3D objects for personal projects by simply describing them.

useCases.title: Design Brainstorming
useCases.description: Generating multiple variations of a design rapidly by tweaking the text prompts to explore different concepts.

useCases.title: Automated Handoffs
useCases.description: Automatically generating DXF files or valid G-code from natural language prompts to stream straight into fabrication equipment.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Makers, designers, engineers, and developers who want to quickly generate 3D models and prototypes programmatically without spending hours manually modeling in complex GUI-based CAD software. The platform simplifies complex workflows and accelerates development timelines.

text-to-cad

The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows for generating 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files. It also does design for manufacturing checks, generates engineering drawings, and connects to popular 3D printing, sheet metal and CNC fabrication services.

It is supported by all popular agents that support plugins or the skills framework, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and Grok.

How it works

  1. Your agent writes each model as a Python script with build123d, built on Open CASCADE.
  2. Running the script, python model.py, builds the model with text-to-cad's server into an .xbf document (its parts, names, colours, materials and joints) and the STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files the script declares. The server keeps each model's work in memory, so an edit rebuilds only what it changed.
  3. The CAD viewer shows the model in your agent app or your browser, and follows every rebuild.

🚀 Quickstart

macOS and Linux:

curl -fsSL https://texttocad.dev/install.sh | sh

Windows, in PowerShell:

irm https://www.texttocad.dev/install.ps1 | iex

It installs uv if it is missing, then sets up text-to-cad in every agent app on your computer with each app's own commands (the plugin, which brings the skills and CAD's MCP server, or for an agent without a plugin the skills alone), registers the cad command, and moves CAD's server to the new release. Run it again to update everything, or click CAD's update button when it shows one; it lists the apps to restart.

Then ask your agent for a part or an assembly: it writes the model as a Python script, runs it to build the model and shows it in the CAD viewer.

Installing by hand, app by app, and updates: docs/install.md

🧰 Skills

Install the library to give agents focused workflows for CAD, fabrication, robot description files, simulation, and local review.

Skill Summary Source
CAD Creates and edits CAD models from plain-language or image requests as Python scripts, built into XBF documents with STEP, STL, 3MF and GLB exports. skills/cad
step.parts Finds off-the-shelf STEP parts like screws, bearings, motors, and connectors. skills/step-parts
Engineering Drawing Dimensioned engineering drawings from a part, as a PDF: views, hidden lines, dimensions, hole callouts, title block. skills/engineering-drawing
DXF Creates 2D DXF drawings like profiles, templates, gaskets, and cut layouts from Python sources or CAD geometry. skills/dxf
URDF Writes robot structure files with links, joints, limits, inertials, and meshes. skills/urdf
SRDF Adds MoveIt planning groups, end effectors, poses, and collision rules to a URDF. skills/srdf
SDF Creates simulator models and worlds with frames, physics, sensors, and lights. skills/sdf
SendCutSend Checks DXF and STEP files before upload to SendCutSend. skills/sendcutsend
DfAM Check Measures mesh printability per process: wall thickness, overhangs, support volume, and build orientation. skills/dfam-check
DFM Reviews a part for sheet metal, CNC machining, or injection molding, with measured evidence and the cited rule behind every finding; measures draft, undercuts and projected area from a mesh. skills/dfm
G-code Slices models into printer-ready G-code with OrcaSlicer, using your own printer presets. skills/gcode
Bambu Labs Sends prints to Bambu Lab printers through Bambu Connect, Bambu Lab's official app, or Bambu Studio. skills/bambu-labs

🛠️ Contributing

text-to-cad is MIT-licensed and built in the open.

  • Bugs and plugin requests: open an issue. A bug report with the model script and the output of cad doctor is the fastest to fix, and an agent app without a plugin gets one on request. A security problem is reported privately, as SECURITY.md says.
  • Questions, ideas and what you made: the Discord. Say what the skills got wrong, too: that is what improves them.
  • Code, skills and models: a new skill (a fabrication service, a printer, a CAD workflow) goes in skills/, an example model in models/, and fixes anywhere. CONTRIBUTING.md has the local setup and how to test in the agent apps; an agent working in the repository starts at AGENTS.md.

By default, text-to-cad sends usage stats and crash reports, tagged with a random ID and never including your files, paths or prompts. The privacy policy says what is sent and how to turn it off.
